In its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company states that it will pursue facility management through effective diversification and group expansion leading to the development of the Building Maintenance Business, and through energy-saving and cost-reduction proposals, stricter, faster and more efficient management operations enabled by DX, and stronger coordination among group companies.
